title: Roadmap
description: This roadmap tracks stable and beta releases alongside planned product releases. Target dates may move depending on testing results.

releases.title: Dynamic notifications
releases.statusText: Released as the current stable version.
summary: Seven-day calibration and local smart timing.
Dynamic reminder planning with local-only data.

releases.title: Completion UI stability
scope: Prevent clipped text and overlapping undo actions.
Verify responsive behavior across Android sizes.

releases.title: Widget/App lifecycle reconciliation
summary: Improve state synchronization between app, widgets and background actions.
scope: Introduce reliable `rehydrate → reconcile → publish` lifecycle flow.
Sync external widget/headless changes back into active app state.
Ensure Reminder and App Lock use fresh state after resume.
Preserve widget idempotency and avoid refresh loops.

rationale.title: Reason before larger features
items: Provides the state consistency foundation required by future background features.

releases.title: Automatic update client
summary: Add the client update experience on top of the existing Release API.
releases.note: The release API and release infrastructure already exist. This release focuses on the application experience.

releases.title: Habit Experience and Onboarding v3

implementationOrder.title: Canonical habit schedule semantics.
items: Daily, fixed-day and flexible weekly behavior.
Shared progress model for Today, Analytics, Reminders and future App Block.

implementationOrder.title: Onboarding navigation foundation.
items: Replace step switching with a proper navigation flow.

implementationOrder.title: Manual habit creation parity.
items: Reuse the same reminder components outside onboarding.

releases.goal: Avoid multiple independent implementations of schedule and reminder behavior.

releases.title: Persistent Habiter Runtime
summary: Introduce a shared background runtime for adaptive reminders and future focus features.
scope: Convert the existing Android foreground service into a shared Habiter runtime.
Support adaptive reminder evaluation while the UI is closed.
Keep reminder business logic in Dart/domain code.
Replace App-Lock-specific watchdog behavior with targeted runtime recovery.
Share background and battery prerequisites across runtime features.

releases.title: App Block 2.0
summary: Add local distraction discovery and habit-based app blocking.
releases.goal: Build App Block on stable foundations instead of duplicating runtime, schedule or lifecycle logic.

major.description: Reserved for incompatible product/data/platform changes. Current planned work does not require a major release.
